# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The user prefers to run builds and unit tests themselves; do not run them automatically unless explicitly requested.
- When the user says a change is OK, treat that as confirmation they have run the build and tests; do not ask them to reconfirm test execution.
- Speed up agent-assisted implementation by grouping only small, independent tasks, while preserving quality, safety, and code reviews after every five individual deliverables.
